newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Jan/Feb coffee imports up at 2.39 mln bags.
newsitem.headline: German Jan/Feb coffee imports up at 2.39 mln bags.

text.p: German net green coffee imports from outside the European Union totalled 2.39 million bags in January/February 1997 after 1.73 million bags in the same period last year, the DKV coffee association said.
February imports were 1.13 million bags compared with 859,765 bags in February 1996.
The 1996 import total was 11.98 million bags.

Leading suppliers in February were listed in the following order -- Colombia 229,449 bags (222,833 in January), Brazil 201,623 (231,776), El Salvador 101,012 (65,253), Vietnam 94,222 (89,689) and Honduras 63,250 (55,954).
